purpose: Trace the same fit-only spoken color contrast through Omni's audio-to-language connector
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
hook: thinker.model.audio_tower.proj output after adjacent-encoder-row pooling, before masked_scatter into language embeddings
row_rule: projected row nominal center lies in fixed waveform word slot; separate whole changed attention chunk and equal-count different-chunk controls
primary_endpoint: complete answer equals donor color with normal EOS
limitations: Connector rows inherit full self-attention chunk context; nominal center is not an independent word boundary. One color contrast is fit-only.
